sentences.text:
Order Sheet
04.10.2024
Ms. Aditi Diwan, counsel for the applicant.
Heard on I.A. No. 1, an application for grant of interim relief/stay.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that a claim case was filed by the non-applicants claiming therein compensation and it was filed beyond period of six months along with an application for condonation of delay under Section 5 of Limitation Act which was allowed by the learned Ist Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bastar at Jagdalpur (C.G.).

entities.text: Ist Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bastar at Jagdalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: She argues that there is no provision for condonation of delay, particularly in Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, therefore, the learned tribunal committed an error of law in allowing such application.

Taking into consideration the submission made here-in-above, purely as an interim measure, there shall be a stay on further proceeding of Claim Case No. 187 of 2024 pending before I st Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bastar at Jagdalpur, till the next date of hearing Issue notice to non-applicants No. 1 and 2 on payment of P.F. by ordinary as well as registered mode.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bastar at Jagdalpur
entities.label: COURT
